ex.zh: 委员会已完成新安全条例的初稿。

ex.zh: 议员们将起草一项保护消费者数字隐私的法案。

ex.zh: 他把草稿用电子邮件发给了导师，请对方在周五前提出意见。

ex.en: Wasted time is a drag on Americans economic and private lives.
ex.zh: 浪费的时间会拖累美国人的经济和私人生活。

ex.zh: 他拖着沉重的行李箱穿过站台去赶火车。

ex.en: Workers dragged the fallen branches off the road after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，工人们把吹落的树枝拖离道路。

ex.en: A native literary drama had been created.
ex.zh: 一种本土的文学戏剧已然形成。

ex.zh: 这起审判吸引了强烈的公众关注和没完没了的媒体渲染。

ex.zh: 加入国家剧院之前，她在大学学习戏剧。

ex.en: Poems can be dramatic, funny, beautiful, moving and inspiring.
ex.zh: 诗歌可以是戏剧性的、有趣的、美丽的、感人的和鼓舞人心的。

ex.zh: 过去十年间，大学毕业生的数量急剧增加。

ex.en: The patient's condition showed dramatic improvement after the operation.
ex.zh: 手术后病人的状况明显好转。

adv. 戏剧性地；引人注目地

ex.en: The bodies playing major professional sports have changed dramatically over the years.
ex.zh: 多年来，从事主要职业运动的运动员身材发生了巨大的变化。

ex.en: The cost of solar power has fallen dramatically in the past decade.
ex.zh: 过去十年，太阳能发电的成本急剧下降。

ex.en: Online shopping has dramatically changed consumer habits worldwide.
ex.zh: 网络购物极大地改变了全球消费者的习惯。

senses: adj. 激烈的,猛烈的;烈性的
adj. 极端的；急剧的；严厉的；猛烈的
drastic.usage: 派生drastically adv.激烈地,严厉地；dra(谐音“抓”)+stic(联想stick“棍子”)→动不动抓起棍子打人，太极端了→极端的；drastic measures/changes 严厉的措施/剧烈的变化；真 drastic technological change 剧烈的技术变革；索引p407

ex.zh: 在经济和人口结构发生巨大变化的背景下

ex.zh: 政府采取严厉措施遏制失控的通货膨胀。

ex.zh: 大幅削减公共开支将使最贫困的家庭受损最重。

ex.en: The exhibition is expected to draw thousands of visitors to the city.
ex.zh: 这次展览预计将吸引数千名游客来到这座城市。

ex.en: She learned to draw before she could write.
ex.zh: 她在学会写字之前就学会了画画。

ex.zh: 调查人员从同一组数据中得出了不同的结论。

phrases.p: the drawback of the new system

ex.en: Although a search agent worked for Redmon, career experts see drawbacks.
ex.zh: 尽管搜索引擎对雷德蒙有用，职业专家们还是看到了一些弊端。

ex.en: The main drawback of working from home is the blurring of work and life.
ex.zh: 居家办公的主要缺点是工作与生活的界限模糊。

ex.en: High costs remain a serious drawback to the widespread use of electric trucks.
ex.zh: 高成本仍是电动卡车普及的一大不利因素。

senses: n. 开票人,出票人;绘图员
drawer.usage: 助记:draw(抽出)+er(表示物)→被抽出的东西→抽屉

ex.en: The child's drawing of the family won first prize in the competition.
ex.zh: 这个孩子画的家庭图画在比赛中获得了一等奖。

ex.en: Architectural drawings of the new library were published online.
ex.zh: 新图书馆的建筑图纸已在网上公布。

ex.en: A charcoal drawing by the artist sold for a record price.
ex.zh: 这位艺术家的一幅素描以创纪录的价格售出。

ex.en: The boat drifted out to sea after its anchor broke loose.
ex.zh: 锚松脱后，小船漂流到了外海。

ex.en: Many young graduates drift from one job to another without a clear plan.
ex.zh: 许多年轻毕业生没有明确的规划，从一个工作换到另一个。

ex.en: Economists detected a gradual drift of workers from rural areas to coastal cities.
ex.zh: 经济学家注意到劳动力正逐渐从农村地区流向沿海城市。

adj. 两部分的;二元的;双重的

ex.en: They consider the plan to be of dubious benefit to most families.
ex.zh: 他们认为这项计划对大多数家庭不一定有好处。

ex.en: Investors grew dubious about the startup's promise of guaranteed returns.
ex.zh: 投资者对这家初创公司保证回报的承诺越发怀疑。

ex.zh: 这份报告所依赖的统计数据准确性存疑。

ex.zh: 期末报告应于本月底提交。

ex.en: The flight was delayed due to thick fog at the airport.
ex.zh: 航班因机场大雾而延误。

ex.zh: 经过慎重考虑，委员会驳回了上诉。

ex.en: There's no point in duplicating work already done.
ex.zh: 重复别人已经做过的工作毫无意义。

ex.zh: 修改文件前请先复制一份，以防万一。

ex.zh: 助手注意到表格里有两个条目是重复的。

ex.zh: 批量生产的服装，就像快餐一样，满足了饥饿感和需求，但却不耐用且浪费。

ex.en: The stress women confront tends to be durable and frequent.
ex.zh: 女性所遭遇的压力往往是持久的，频繁的。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly prefer durable goods that can be repaired rather than replaced.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越青睐可以维修而非一坏就换的耐用商品。

ex.en: But among student subjects who discussed meat ethics, meal purchases containing meat decreased from 52 to 45 percent—and this effect held steady for the study's duration of several weeks.
ex.zh: 但是，在参与探讨肉食伦理的学生受试人群中，肉餐购买比率从52%下降到45%——而且这一影响在研究持续的几周内一直保持平稳。

ex.en: The duration of the experiment was limited to six months.
ex.zh: 实验的持续时间限定为六个月。

ex.en: Passengers must remain seated for the duration of the flight.
ex.zh: 乘客在飞行全程必须留在座位上。

senses: prep. 在……期间；在……期间的某个时候

ex.en: Many shops stay closed during the national holiday.
ex.zh: 国庆假期期间许多商店不营业。

ex.en: She developed an interest in physics during her school years.
ex.zh: 她在中学时期培养了对物理的兴趣。

ex.en: The roof was badly damaged during the storm.
ex.zh: 屋顶在暴风雨中严重受损。

dusk.usage: 黄昏dusk时他们把鸭子duck赶回了鸭舍

ex.en: The street lights go on at dusk.
ex.zh: 街灯在黄昏时分亮起来。

ex.en: The birds return to the woods at dusk to rest.
ex.zh: 鸟儿黄昏时分归林栖息。

ex.en: From the summit we watched the sky turn orange at dusk.
ex.zh: 我们在山顶看着黄昏的天空变成橙色。

ex.zh: 她在北美游牧民中生活了十年。

ex.zh: 它专门为城市居民提供了一些休闲之地。

ex.zh: 在一个案例中，许多研究人员通过使用航空照片和徒步考察，已经确定了数百个小村庄和个体住宅的位置。

ex.zh: 在一个案例中，许多围绕着洪都拉斯的玛雅古城科潘开展工作的研究人员通过航拍技术和徒步勘测找到了成百个小村庄和民居。

ex.en: The flood destroyed hundreds of dwellings along the river bank.
ex.zh: 洪水摧毁了河岸沿岸数百处住宅。

ex.zh: 他年轻、精力充沛，是广告公司的管理人员。

ex.en: The market is highly dynamic, with consumer preferences changing every season.
ex.zh: 这个市场充满变化，消费者偏好每个季度都在改变。

ex.zh: 随着在线教学的兴起，师生之间的互动模式发生了变化。

ex.zh: 一张张热切的小脸仰着头听着。

ex.en: Fresh graduates are eager to gain practical experience in their chosen fields.
ex.zh: 应届毕业生渴望在所选领域获得实践经验。

ex.en: The company is eager to expand its share of the rapidly growing electric car market.
ex.zh: 该公司渴望扩大其在快速增长的电动汽车市场的份额。

ex.zh: 学生们的求知热忱给来访教授留下了深刻印象。

ex.en: He accepted the offer with eagerness, without negotiating the salary.
ex.zh: 他急切地接受了这份工作，连薪水都没有谈。

ex.zh: 她对赞美的渴望有时使她夸大自己的成果。

ex.zh: 如今普通劳动者的收入远低于四十年前。

ex.zh: 她赢得了强硬而公平的谈判者之名。

ex.zh: 如今年轻运动员能从广告合同中赚取数百万。

ex.zh: 尽管她已尽心竭力，但是仍然找不到工作。

ex.en: He is an earnest young man who takes every task seriously.
ex.zh: 他是个认真的年轻人，对待每项任务都一丝不苟。

ex.zh: 讨论以玩笑开始，却以认真告终。

ex.zh: 这款新软件可以减轻家务负担，让人们有更多闲暇时间。

ex.zh: 令大家惊讶的是，她第一次尝试就轻松通过了驾照考试。

ex.zh: 指责技术很容易，但习惯才是更深层的原因。

ex.zh: 这次考试比大多数学生预料的容易。

ex.zh: 她随和的态度很快让紧张的候选人放松下来。

n. 古怪的人；偏心器,偏心轮
eccentric.usage: ec(脱离)+centr(中心)+ic→反常的;派生eccentrically adv.古怪地;eccentricity n.怪异；ec（出去）+centric（联想成center“中心”）→偏离中心的，偏离主流的→古怪的。

senses: v. 遮住…的光；（力量、成就等）超出，使黯然失色

ex.en: A total eclipse of the sun drew huge crowds to the coastal city.
ex.zh: 日全食吸引大批人群来到这座海滨城市。

ex.en: The young actress soon eclipsed her famous mother in popularity.
ex.zh: 这位年轻女演员的名气很快超过了她著名的母亲。

ex.en: The once dominant firm was eclipsed by nimble startup competitors.
ex.zh: 这家曾经占据主导地位的公司被灵活的初创对手抢过了风头。

ecological.usage: adj.生态（学）的；主张生态保 护的

senses: adv. 从生态学的观点看

phrases.p: severely damage the ecology of western states
phrases.m: 严重破坏西部各州的生态

ecology.usage: [族] ecological a. 生态的；ecosystem n. 生态系统；记：eco（生态）+-logy（名词后缀）→生态；eco(生态)+logy(学科)→生态学;派生ecological adj.生态的;ecologist n.生态学家；n.生态学，社会生态学，个体生 态学

ex.en: The course covers the ecology of forests, wetlands and grasslands.
ex.zh: 这门课程涵盖森林、湿地和草原的生态。

ex.en: Scientists warn that the region's fragile ecology could collapse within decades.
ex.zh: 科学家警告，该地区脆弱的生态可能在几十年内崩溃。

ex.en: The study of ecology helps explain how species depend on one another.
ex.zh: 生态学研究有助于解释物种之间如何相互依存。

senses: adj. 经济上的,经济学的
adj. 有利可图的,合算的

ex.en: Political power depends upon economic strength.
ex.zh: 政治权力取决于经济实力。

ex.en: The government introduced a series of policies to achieve steady economic growth.
ex.zh: 政府出台了一系列政策以实现稳定的经济增长。

ex.en: The region has suffered a severe economic decline since the local coal mines closed.
ex.zh: 自当地煤矿关闭以来，该地区经济严重衰退。

senses: adj. 节约的,节俭的,经济的;省时间的
adj. 经济的，实惠的；节俭的；简洁的
economical.usage: 辨析:economical节约实用;economic与经济有关的;反义:uneconomical浪费的；索引p407

ex.en: Solid fuel would be more economical.
ex.zh: 固体燃料会更加经济。

ex.en: Here's his advice for economical foodies.
ex.zh: 下面是他的建议，教你如何吃得省钱。

ex.en: Buying in bulk is economical only if you actually use everything you purchase.
ex.zh: 只有当你确实把买来的东西都用完时，批量购买才划算。

economically.usage: adv.在经济上；经济地；节约地；索引p407

ex.en: Services could be operated more efficiently and economically.
ex.zh: 可以更有效、更经济地提供服务。

ex.en: The region remains economically dependent on a single crop.
ex.zh: 该地区在经济上仍然依赖单一作物。

ex.en: Students learned to use energy more economically in daily life.
ex.zh: 学生们学会了在日常生活中更节约地使用能源。

senses: n. 经济学;经济原则;国家的经济状况

ex.en: They may cooperate directly in the growing number of international projects related to science, economics and industry.
ex.zh: 他们可能在日益增多的与科学、经济学和工业有关的跨国项目中直接合作。

ex.en: In just one generation, millions of mothers have gone to work, transforming basic family economics.
ex.zh: 仅相隔了一代人的时间，数百万母亲外出工作，改变了基本的经济状况。

ex.en: She studied economics at university before joining the central bank.
ex.zh: 她上大学时攻读经济学，之后进入了中央银行工作。

ex.en: The economist predicts that inflation will fall below three percent next year.
ex.zh: 这位经济学家预测明年通胀率将降至百分之三以下。

ex.en: As an economist, he focuses on the labor market rather than financial markets.
ex.zh: 作为一名经济学家，他关注的是劳动力市场而非金融市场。

ex.en: Government economists underestimated the social costs of the rapid privatization.
ex.zh: 政府的经济学家们低估了快速私有化带来的社会成本。

economy.usage: [族] economic a. 经济的；economical a. 节约的；economics n. 经济学；economist n. 经济学家；[族]economics n. 经济学；n.经济；索引p407

ex.en: Tourism clearly dominates the local economy.
ex.zh: 旅游业明显主导着当地经济。

ex.en: The global economy is expected to recover slowly in the coming years.
ex.zh: 全球经济预计在未来几年将缓慢复苏。

ex.en: Sharing goods and services can strengthen the local economy and reduce waste.
ex.zh: 共享商品和服务可以增强本地经济并减少浪费。

ecosystem.usage: n.生态系统；联想记忆：eco(生态，经济)+system(系统)→生态系统；索引p407

ex.en: Wetlands form an ecosystem that supports a remarkable variety of birds.
ex.zh: 湿地构成一个供养种类繁多鸟类的生态系统。

ex.en: Removing one species can upset the balance of an entire ecosystem.
ex.zh: 移除一个物种可能破坏整个生态系统的平衡。

ex.en: The company built a digital ecosystem connecting buyers, sellers and banks.
ex.zh: 该公司构建了一个连接买家、卖家和银行的数字生态系统。

edge.usage: have the edge on/over sb./sth.比……有优势

senses: adj. 可以吃的,可食用的
edible.usage: 辨析:edible指可食用的、适合食用的;eatable指某物新鲜或烹调好可食用;反义:inedible

ex.en: Students will be taught how to edit and proofread.
ex.zh: 学生将被教授如何编辑和校对。

ex.en: Editors often edit long reports down to a single readable page.
ex.zh: 编辑常常把冗长的报告删改成可读的一页。

ex.en: She was invited to edit a special issue on climate economics.
ex.zh: 她受邀主编一期关于气候经济学的特刊。

edition.usage: [族]editor n. 编辑；edit(编辑)+ion(名词后缀)→版本

ex.en: The dictionary's latest edition includes thousands of new words.
ex.zh: 这部词典的最新版收录了数千个新词。

ex.en: The morning edition of the paper carried the full interview.
ex.zh: 报纸的晨版刊登了访谈全文。

ex.en: A paperback edition of the novel will appear next spring.
ex.zh: 这部小说的平装版将在明年春天面世。

editor.usage: edit(编辑)+or(名词后缀表示人)→编者

ex.en: The editor asked her to shorten the article by one third.
ex.zh: 编辑请她把文章删减三分之一。

ex.en: As managing editor, he decides which stories appear on the front page.
ex.zh: 作为主编，他决定哪些报道登上头版。

ex.en: A good editor improves clarity without silencing the writer's voice.
ex.zh: 好的编辑能提升表达的清晰度，又不抹杀作者的风格。

editorial.usage: editor(编辑)+i+al(形容词后缀)→编辑的；索引p407

senses: vt.（在学校）教育；教导；教养；训练
n. 教育,教育体制;知识;修养

effect.usage: ef-(外)+fect(做)→做出来的结果→效果；[族] effective；have an effect on...对……有影响；in effect实际上；be of no effect 没有作用,无效力；ef（加强）+fect（做）→反复做→实现；拓展：in effect 事实上；实际上；take effect 开

ex.en: All of which would, of course, have a positive effect on our happiness levels.
ex.zh: 当然，所有这些都会对我们的幸福水平产生积极的影响。

ex.en: But CCT programs don't generally consider effects on the environment.
ex.zh: 但是CCT计划通常不会考虑对环境的影响。

ex.en: Scientists are studying the effect of sleep loss on memory and decision-making.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究睡眠不足对记忆和决策的影响。

senses: adj. 有效的,生效的,得力的
adj. 有效的；产生预期效果的；实际的；生效的
effective.usage: [辨]effective有效的；efficient高效的；辨析:effective有效的;effectual最终奏效的;efficacious灵验的(药);efficient效率高的；adj.有效的、起作用的；易混：effective 有效果的，名词形式effectiveness 意为效果；索引p407

ex.en: His hard work is effective.
ex.zh: 他的努力工作很有成效。

ex.en: While the researchers assumed that the well-structured daily plans would be most effective when it came to the execution of tasks, they were wrong: the detailed daily plans demotivated students.
ex.zh: 虽然研究人员认为详尽的每日计划在执行（学习）任务时最有效，但他们错了：详细的每日计划会导致学生的积极性下降。

ex.en: Regular exercise combined with a balanced diet is an effective way to control weight.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼加上均衡饮食是控制体重的有效方法。

senses: adv. 有效地,生效地;实际上
effectively.usage: adv.有效地；实际上，事实上；索引p407

ex.en: The new rules effectively ban smoking in all public indoor spaces.
ex.zh: 新规定实际上禁止在所有室内公共场所吸烟。

ex.en: She manages the department effectively with a small, well-trained team.
ex.zh: 她用一支训练有素的小团队高效地管理着该部门。

ex.en: Without reliable data, the policy cannot be evaluated effectively.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的数据，就无法有效评估这项政策。

ex.en: The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility, shareholder value, business-friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation.
ex.zh: 人们认为有意义的字眼是效率、灵活性、股东价值、商业友好、财富创造、销售量、影响力，以及对报业来讲的发行量。

ex.en: New software has greatly improved the efficiency of the shipping department.
ex.zh: 新软件大大提高了货运部门的效率。

ex.en: Energy efficiency standards now apply to all newly built apartment blocks.
ex.zh: 能效标准现在适用于所有新建公寓楼。

efficient.usage: ef-(出)+fic(做)+-ient→做得出→高效的；[族] efficiency n. 效率；反 inefficient；[近]inefficient a. 效率低的；adj.生效的，效率高的；(人) 有能力的，能胜任的；ef（出）+fic（做）+i（I，我）+ent→我能很快做出辣的→效率高的；易混：effici

ex.en: The emergency services are efficient.
ex.zh: 应急服务很有效率。

ex.en: When our brains switch between being focused and unfocused on a task, they tend to be more efficient.
ex.zh: 在完成一项任务时，如果我们的大脑能在专注和不专注之间切换，大脑往往会更高效。

ex.en: The new engine is far more efficient than the old one, consuming much less fuel.
ex.zh: 新发动机比旧发动机效率高得多，油耗也少得多。

phrases.p: make an effort to do sth.

effort.usage: endeavor 的近义词；make an effort to do sth.努力做某事；in a joint (common) effort 共同努力；make an effort/efforts to do sth.努力做某事；take efforts付出努力；索引p407

ex.en: The study based on an area in Mexico is cited to show that antipoverty efforts require the participation of local farmers.
ex.zh: 文中引用这一基于墨西哥某地区的研究是为了表明，扶贫工作需要当地农民的参与。

ex.en: Learning a language well requires sustained effort over many years.
ex.zh: 学好一门语言需要多年持续的努力。

ex.en: The rescue effort continued through the night despite the heavy snow.
ex.zh: 尽管大雪纷飞，救援工作仍彻夜进行。

effusive.usage: adj.流露感激之情的；喷 发的

ego.usage: 同根:egocentric自我中心的;egoist自我主义者;egotism自负,自大

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

senses: adj. (两者之中)任一的,任何一个的

eject.usage: 助记:e(出去)+ject(投,射,扔)→射出去→喷射;派生ejection n.排泄,喷出；v.驱逐；喷射，排出；弹出；词根词缀法：e（表示“出去”）+ject（抛，扔）→往外扔→驱逐。；e（出去）+ject（抛，扔）→往外扔→驱逐

ex.en: Police ejected a number of violent protesters from the hall.
ex.zh: 警察将一些暴力抗议者赶出了会议厅。

ex.en: The pilot ejected safely moments before the jet crashed.
ex.zh: 飞行员在战机坠毁前一刻安全弹射逃生。

ex.en: The volcano periodically ejects ash and steam high into the air.
ex.zh: 火山周期性地把火山灰和蒸汽喷向高空。

senses: adj. 精心计划(或制作)的,详尽的,复杂的
adj. 精心制作的；详细的
v. 详细描述；精心制作
adj. 精心制作的；复杂的；详尽的
elaborate.usage: 同义:detail;派生:elaboration n.精心计划;详述；adj.复杂的，详尽的；精心制 作的 v.详细说明，详尽阐述；e(出去)+labor(劳动)+ate(动词后缀)→把你劳动的过程"详细描述"出来→详细描述；详细的；词根:e(out出)+labor(劳动)+ate→通过劳动做出来→精心制作；动词读ɪ'

ex.en: The ceiling was tiled in an elaborate pattern.
ex.zh: 天花板的铺设做得很精致。

ex.en: To the horror of some who expected a Greek Revival twin of the Treasury Building to be erected on the other side of the White House, the elaborate French Second Empire style design by Alfred Mullett was selected.
ex.zh: 一些人希望在白宫的另一边建一座希腊复兴风格的财政大楼，但令他们感到震惊的是，入选的却是由阿尔弗雷德·穆莱特精心设计的法兰西第二帝国建筑风格的方案。

ex.en: Officials refused to elaborate on the details of the security plan.
ex.zh: 官员们拒绝详细说明安全方案的细节。

elapse.usage: e（出）+laps（滑，滑走）+e→滑出去了→消逝，流逝。

ex.en: Many years had elapsed before they returned to their original urban areas.
ex.zh: 许多年过去了，他们才回到原来的城市地区。

elastic.usage: 助记:e(加强)+last(持续)+ic(形容词后缀)→可以持续的→弹性的；e（出去）+last（延续，持续）+ic→延伸出去拉长→有弹性的

ex.en: The new policy was sufficiently elastic to accommodate both views.
ex.zh: 新政策充分灵活地兼顾到了两种观点。

elder.usage: elder指年长者；older指年龄较大的

senses: a. 当选而尚未就职的
elect.usage: elect sb. as...推选某人为……；派生elector n.选民,选举人;electoral adj.选举的,选举人的；e（出去）+lect（选择）→选出去→选举，推选。；索引p407

ex.en: Voters will elect a new president at the end of this month.
ex.zh: 选民将于本月底选出一位新总统。

ex.en: Members elect the chairperson from among themselves every two years.
ex.zh: 成员每两年从他们中间选举产生主席。

ex.en: More and more graduates elect to work in smaller cities where housing is affordable.
ex.zh: 越来越多的毕业生选择到住房负担得起的小城市工作。

ex.en: The general election will be held on the first Tuesday of November.
ex.zh: 大选将在11月的第一个星期二举行。

ex.en: Election results suggested that voters cared most about jobs and healthcare.
ex.zh: 选举结果表明，选民最关心的是就业和医疗。

ex.en: She won the election by a narrow margin of two hundred votes.
ex.zh: 她以两百票的微弱优势赢得了选举。

senses: adj. 电的,导电的,电动的
adj. 电的；电动的；供电的
electric.usage: 同根(词根electr电):electrician电工;electricity电;electrode电极,电焊条;electron电子；真题词组亦见：electric vehicles 电动车辆；electric cars 电动小汽车；索引p407

ex.en: The city plans to replace all its buses with electric vehicles within a decade.
ex.zh: 该市计划在十年内用电动汽车替换所有公交车。

ex.en: An electric current passes through the wire when the switch is closed.
ex.zh: 开关闭合时，电流便通过导线。

ex.en: The crowd's cheers created an electric atmosphere in the stadium.
ex.zh: 人群的欢呼声在体育场里营造出火热的气氛。

senses: adj. 与电有关的；电的；发电的
electrical.usage: 助记:electric(电的)+al(形容词后缀)→电的；索引p407

electrician.usage: 助记:electric(电的)+ian(名词后缀表示人)→电工

ex.en: The village finally gained access to electricity ten years ago.
ex.zh: 这个村庄十年前终于通上了电。

ex.en: Electricity prices rise sharply during the cold winter months.
ex.zh: 寒冷的冬季月份电价急剧上涨。

ex.en: Wind turbines now generate almost a fifth of the country's electricity.
ex.zh: 风力发电机如今的发电量接近全国电力的五分之一。

senses: vt. 使带电；使电气化；使激动

ex.en: Twenty-seven students were told which pens were electrified; another twenty-seven were told only that some were electrified.
ex.zh: 27名学生被告知哪些圆珠笔带电；另外27名学生则仅被告知有一些圆珠笔带电。

electron.usage: 发音类似一来可愁→电子化时代很多孩子容易沉迷玩游戏，父母发愁→电子

ex.en: The electron microscope uses a beam of electrons to produce images at high magnifications.
ex.zh: 电子显微镜利用一束电子产生高倍放大的影像。

senses: adj. 电子的；电子设备的
electronic.usage: adj.电子的，电子学的；拓展：electronic money 电子货币；易混词辨析：electronic指电子的；electric通常指使用或产生电力的；electrical多指本身不产生电但与电有关；索引p407

ex.en: Airline passengers no longer have to turn off all electronic devices while on the plane.
ex.zh: 飞机上的乘客不再需要关闭所有的电子设备。

ex.en: Electronic payment has replaced cash in many shops, especially in large cities.
ex.zh: 电子支付已在许多商店取代了现金，尤其在大城市。

ex.en: The library offers free access to a wide range of electronic books and journals.
ex.zh: 图书馆提供免费访问大量电子书籍和期刊的服务。

ex.en: Elegance, he believed, did not derive from abundance.
ex.zh: 他相信，优雅并不源于富足。

senses: adj. 优雅的,优美的,精致的
adj. 优雅的，端庄的；精美的
adj. 优雅的；精美的；简洁的
elegant.usage: [族]elegance n. 优雅；[近]graceful a. 优雅的；反义:inelegant;派生:elegance n.高雅,典雅,优雅；e（=ex出来）+leg（=lig=lect挑选）+ant（形容词后缀）→挑选出的，一定是美好的→优雅的，端庄的。；词根记忆: e(out, 出)+leg(choose, 选

ex.en: She was tall and elegant.
ex.zh: 她身材修长，优雅大方。

ex.en: The mathematician offered an elegant solution that solved two problems at once.
ex.zh: 这位数学家给出了一个简洁巧妙的解法，一举解决了两个问题。

ex.en: The hotel's elegant design attracts business travelers from all over the world.
ex.zh: 这家酒店精美雅致的设计吸引了世界各地的商务旅客。

element.usage: [族]elementary a. 基本的；发音类似"饿了么"→吃点东西是生活最基本的部分；派生elementary adj.基本的；索引p407

ex.en: While climate is a key element, it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation.
ex.zh: 虽然气候是一个关键因素，但它不应该以牺牲其他因素为代价。

ex.en: Trust is an essential element in any successful working relationship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何成功的工作关系中必不可少的要素。

ex.en: Water is composed of the elements hydrogen and oxygen.
ex.zh: 水由氢和氧两种元素组成。

senses: adj. 基本的；基础的，初级的
elementary.usage: element+-ary→要素的→基本的；[近] basic；辨析:elementary初步;basic根本;essential核心必需;fundamental首要;primary最初;反义:advanced；adj.简单的，基本的；初级的； 小学的；拓展：elementary study of English 英语的

ex.en: Elementary education lays the foundation for all later learning.
ex.zh: 初等教育为日后的一切学习奠定基础。

ex.en: It is elementary economics that prices rise when demand exceeds supply.
ex.zh: 需求超过供给时价格就会上涨，这是基本的经济学常识。

ex.en: The elementary school near the campus is attended mostly by faculty children.
ex.zh: 校园附近那所小学的学生大多是教职员工的孩子。

senses: vt. 举起；提高；提拔；使兴高采烈
elevate.usage: [族]elevation n. 提高；海拔；辨析:elevate举起/提升/晋升;hoist提起升起,常指机器升起绞起;lift侧重将重物提起离地;反义lower使降低;派生elevated adj.提高的,高尚的；ele(爱丽)+v+ate(动词后缀)→爱丽为他提升自己→举起；提高；词根记忆：e(out,出)+lev

ex.en: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the standards of a particular industry.
ex.zh: 甚至更好的情况是帮助人们提高对美的理解，以超越某个特定行业的标准。

ex.en: elevate notions of beauty
ex.zh: 提升美的理念

ex.en: Regular reading can elevate your mind and broaden your understanding of the world.
ex.zh: 经常阅读可以提升你的心智，拓宽你对世界的理解。

senses: n. (某地方的)高度,(尤指)海拔
n. (建筑物)立面,立面图,立视图
n. 高地；海拔；提拔；晋级
elevation.usage: n.高度，海拔；提拔，提升；索引p407

ex.en: The city is at an elevation of 2,000 metres.
ex.zh: 这座城市海拔2000米。

ex.en: The higher the elevation of the forest, the fewer species of birds can survive there.
ex.zh: 森林海拔越高，能在那里生存的鸟类物种就越少。

ex.en: The sudden elevation in his social status made some of his old friends uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 他社会地位的突然提升使他的一些老朋友感到不舒服。

ex.en: The elevator was out of service, so we took the stairs.
ex.zh: 电梯停用了，我们只好走楼梯。

ex.en: She pressed the button and the elevator rose swiftly to the tenth floor.
ex.zh: 她按下按钮，电梯迅速升到十楼。

ex.en: The old hotel installed a new elevator to meet safety standards.
ex.zh: 这家老酒店安装了新电梯以满足安全标准。

senses: v. 引出(真理等);探出,诱出(回答等)
elicit.usage: 派生:elicitation n.引出,诱出,启发

senses: adj. 符合条件的,合格的
adj. 有资格的；合格的；具备条件的
adj. 合格的；符合条件的
eligible.usage: [近] qualified a. 合格的；[近]qualified a. 合格的；助记:e(在)+lig(约束)+ible(形容词后缀)→在约束的范围之内的→符合条件的；eli(联想爱丽)+g+ible(可以…的)→爱丽是可以的→合格的，具备条件的；辨：qualified强调具备经验、知识、资质和训练；eligible

ex.en: PreCheck is supposed to be a win-win for travelers and the TSA. Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes.
ex.zh: "预先检验"对于乘客和美国交通安全管理局应该是双赢。通过背景审核的乘客有资格使用快速安检通道。

ex.en: Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes.
ex.zh: 通过背景审核的乘客有资格使用快速安检通道。

ex.en: Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes.
ex.zh: 通过背景调查的旅客有资格使用快速扫描通道。

senses: vt. 消灭(尤指敌人或对手)
eliminate.usage: e-（出）+limin（门槛）+ate→赶出门槛→淘汰。近义：remove vt. 去除；辨析:eliminate排除内部已有;exclude拒绝使不入内;同义:remove,knock out;反义:maintain；eliminate 指彻底去除；elimination n. 消除，淘汰。；词根:e(out向外)+

ex.en: The program aims to eliminate illiteracy.
ex.zh: 该项目旨在消除文盲。

ex.en: Because electronic payments are immediate, they eliminate the float for the consumer.
ex.zh: 由于电子支付是即时的，这让消费者们完全没有“浮动期”。

ex.en: Automatic checkouts have eliminated many of the jobs once done by human cashiers.
ex.zh: 自动结账系统取消了曾经由收银员完成的许多工作。

senses: n. [总称]精英,精华;上层人士,掌权人物
n. 社会精英；上层集团
adj. 精英的，精锐的；出类拔萃的
elite.usage: n.上层人士；精英 adj.出类拔萃的，精锐的；索引p407

ex.en: These people form an elite who have the power to make decisions.
ex.zh: 这些人构成了一个有决定权的精英集团。

ex.en: Only graduates from a few elite universities could enter the profession in the past.
ex.zh: 在过去，只有少数名牌大学的毕业生才能进入这一行业。

ex.en: The report argues that economic policy is shaped by a small political elite.
ex.zh: 该报告指出，经济政策是由一小撮政治精英塑造的。

senses: adj. 雄辩的,口才流利的,有说服力的
adj. 雄辩的；有口才的；流利的
eloquent.usage: 助记:e(加强)+loqu(说)+ent(形容词后缀)→很能说的;同义fluent,persuasive；发音类似"爱唠嗑的"→爱唠嗑的人一般都很能说→雄辩的

ex.en: He grew very eloquent on the subject.
ex.zh: 读到这个话题，他越说越有劲儿。

senses: vt. 逃避，躲避；使达不到；使不记得；使不理解
vi. 上船（或飞机、汽车等）
v. 上船(或飞机、汽车等)
embark.usage: em-（进入）+bark（船）→上船→开始。近义：launch vt. 开始；发起；同义board,start;反义debark v.下船(或飞机、汽车等)；索引p407

ex.en: Passengers embarked on the ferry at Dover for the short crossing.
ex.zh: 乘客们在多佛登上渡轮，进行短程横渡。

ex.en: After graduating, she embarked on a career in public health.
ex.zh: 毕业后，她开始了公共卫生领域的职业生涯。

ex.en: The team embarked on an ambitious project to digitize the national archives.
ex.zh: 该团队启动了一项将国家档案数字化的宏大工程。

senses: vt. 使尴尬；使困惑；使为难；使陷入困境
vt. 使窘迫,使局促不安
v. 使窘迫，使尴尬；使困惑
embarrass.usage: [族]embarrassment n. 尴尬；派生embarrassing adj.令人困窘的;embarrassment n.局促不安,焦急

ex.en: Her questions about my private life embarrassed me.
ex.zh: 她询问我的私生活使我感到很尴尬。

ex.en: He did not want to embarrass his friend by mentioning the debt in public.
ex.zh: 他不想当众提及那笔债务使朋友难堪。

ex.en: It embarrasses many parents when their children argue with them in stores.
ex.zh: 孩子在商店里与他们争执会让许多父母难堪。

ex.en: Though the participants didn't expect a positive experience, after they went through with the experiment, "not a single person reported having been embarrassed."
ex.zh: 尽管实验中的受试者原本就没有期待这会是一次愉快的经历，但在他们完成试验之后，“没有人反映说会感到尴尬”。

ex.en: It is financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing.
ex.zh: 从经济上来说是可怕的，从心理上来说是尴尬的。

senses: n. 尴尬；使人为难的处境
n. 令人为难(或难堪、尴尬)的人

ex.en: With them, there's not the same embarrassment as when buying one carrot in a little greengrocer.
ex.zh: 有了它们，就不会像在小蔬菜水果店买一根胡萝卜那样尴尬。

ex.en: To her embarrassment, she forgot the guest's name during the introduction.
ex.zh: 令她尴尬的是，介绍时她忘了客人的名字。

ex.en: The delays proved a political embarrassment for the transport minister.
ex.zh: 这些延误最终成了交通部长的一桩政治难堪。

senses: n. 大使馆；（统称）使馆官员

ex.en: They broke off diplomatic relations and closed the embassies in each other's country.
ex.zh: 两国中断外交关系，并关闭了在对方国家的大使馆。

ex.en: Visa applications must be submitted to the embassy in person.
ex.zh: 签证申请必须亲自递交到大使馆。

ex.en: The embassy advised its citizens to leave the country immediately.
ex.zh: 大使馆建议本国公民立即离开该国。

senses: vt. 把…牢牢地嵌入（或插入、埋入）
vt. 使插入,使嵌入;深留(记忆中)

ex.en: Not only did they develop such a device but by the turn of the millennium they had also managed to embed it in a worldwide system accessed by billions of people every day.
ex.zh: 他们不仅开发了这样的设备,还在世纪之交,成功将其嵌入一个每天都有数以亿计用户访问的全球系统内。

ex.en: These values are deeply embedded in the nation's legal tradition.
ex.zh: 这些价值观深深植根于该国的法律传统之中。

ex.en: Sensors are embedded in the bridge to monitor structural stress.
ex.zh: 桥梁中嵌入了传感器以监测结构应力。

senses: n. [常用pl.] 余火未尽的木块（或煤块）
n. (体现一种思想或品质的)典型,化身

ex.en: Since his "action" is in the past, the photograph is its sole embodiment.
ex.zh: 因为他的"动作"发生在过去，而照片是唯一的（艺术）载体。

senses: vt. 体现，使具体化；包括，收录
v. 具体表现，体现，代表（思想或品质）；包含；包括
embody.usage: 形近辨析:embrace拥抱;embed埋置;embody体现;emboss使凸出;同义:represent；em(表示"使")+body(身体；形体)→使有形→使具体化；索引p407

ex.en: Achievement happens because you as a person embody the external achievement.
ex.zh: 成功的发生是因为你本身就是这种外部成功的体现。

ex.en: Achievement happens because you as a person embody the external achievement; you don't "get" success but become it.
ex.zh: 之所以有成就，是因为你作为一个人体现了外在的成就；你不是"获得"了成功，而是变得成功。

ex.en: The new library embodies the university's commitment to open learning.
ex.zh: 新图书馆体现了这所大学对开放学习的承诺。

senses: vt. 欣然接受；乐意采纳
vt. 拥抱；包括；欣然接受

phrases.m: 欣然接受新的数字技术

embrace.usage: [近]adopt vt. 采用；同义:hug,hold;accept；词根记忆：em(enter, 进入)+brac(arm, 胳膊)+e→进入臂弯中→拥抱；易混辨析：embrace为正式用词，指把某事物纳入整体之中；索引p407

ex.en: This advice is more relevant now than ever before, even as more parents want to embrace the ideas of their children, despite the current housing crunch.
ex.zh: 即使越来越多的家长不顾当下的住房短缺而愿意接受孩子的想法，这个建议也比以往任何时候都更有意义。

ex.en: The company embraced new technology to cut costs and raise quality.
ex.zh: 该公司欣然采用新技术以降低成本、提高质量。

ex.en: She embraced her son warmly at the airport after his two-year absence.
ex.zh: 儿子离家两年归来，她在机场紧紧拥抱了他。

phrases.m: 在胚胎阶段;在萌芽时期;尚未成熟

senses: vi. 出现；浮现；(事实)暴露
emerge.usage: e-(外)+merg(沉)→从沉没中露出→浮现；[族] emergence n. 出现；派生 emergence n. 出现；emergent adj. 新兴的；adj.新兴的，发展初期的；e（出）+merg（沉，没）+e→水落石出→浮现；出现；2020英语二完形考emerge from；emerge from指"从困

ex.en: No new evidence emerged during the investigation.
ex.zh: 调查过程中未发现新证据。

ex.en: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms.
ex.zh: 和悲伤、恐惧、愤怒等所谓的基本情绪不同，内疚产生的稍晚一些，它是随着孩子对社会和道德规范的理解不断增强而产生的。

ex.en: A clear picture of the accident emerged after the police interviewed all the witnesses.
ex.zh: 警方询问了所有目击者后，事故的清晰情况浮现出来。

emergence.usage: n.出现，显现；崭露头角；摆脱 困境

ex.en: The emergence of cheap sensors transformed the study of wildlife.
ex.zh: 廉价传感器的出现改变了野生动物研究。

ex.en: Economists link the emergence of the middle class to rising education levels.
ex.zh: 经济学家将中产阶级的兴起与教育水平的提高联系起来。

ex.en: The emergence of new political parties has fragmented the parliament.
ex.zh: 新政党的出现使议会趋于分裂。

senses: n. 紧急情况；突发事件
n. 紧急情况，突然事件，非常时刻
n. 突发事件；紧急情况
emergency.usage: emerg(出现)+-ency→突然出现的事→紧急情况；[族]emergent a. 紧急的；n.突发事件，紧急情况；意外事 件；05 "紧急、危机"相关词汇；医院里有急诊（emergency）室；索引p407

ex.en: The government has declared a state of emergency following the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震发生后政府已宣布进入紧急状态。

ex.en: In an emergency, dial this number and the operator will connect you to the police.
ex.zh: 遇到紧急情况时，请拨打这个号码，接线员会为你接通警方。

ex.en: Hospitals must keep an emergency supply of medicine for unexpected disasters.
ex.zh: 医院必须为意外灾害储备急救药品。

senses: n. 移民，移居外国的人
v. 移居外国(或外地区)
emigrate.usage: 助记:e(出去)+migr(迁移)+ate(动词后缀)→移居外国;同根:immigrate移入;migration迁居;migrate迁移;emigration移民出境；v.移居外国，移民；词根:e(out外)+migrate(迁移)→移居国外;辨:emigrate移居出境；索引p407

ex.en: Millions of Europeans emigrated to America during the industrial revolution.
ex.zh: 工业革命期间，数百万欧洲人移居美国。

ex.en: High taxes led many skilled workers to emigrate in search of better opportunities.
ex.zh: 高税收促使许多技术工人移居国外，寻找更好的机会。

ex.en: Her grandparents emigrated from Italy shortly after the war ended.
ex.zh: 她的祖父母在战争结束后不久从意大利移居国外。

senses: adj. ①(指人)著名的，杰出的，卓越的
②(指品质、特性)明显的，突出的
adj. 杰出的，有名的，卓越的
eminent.usage: 同根(min 突出)：supereminent 非常突出的，prominent 突出的，显著的；e（出）+min（伸出，突出）+ent（……的）→比民众突出；索引p407

ex.en: This description even fits the majority of eminent scholars.
ex.zh: 该描述恰好符合大多数的著名学者。

ex.en: His description even fits the majority of eminent scholars.
ex.zh: 他的描述甚至适合大多数著名学者。

ex.en: The conference brought together eminent scientists from more than thirty countries.
ex.zh: 这次会议汇聚了来自三十多个国家的杰出科学家。

senses: n. 发出,射出,排放;排放物;散发物
n. 排放物；(光、热、气等的)发出，射出
emission.usage: emit 的派生词；词根记忆：e(out,出)+miss(send,送,派)+ion(名词后缀)→发出，射出。；索引p407

ex.en: carbon dioxide emissions
ex.zh: 二氧化碳排放

ex.en: The new standards aim to cut carbon emissions from vehicles by a third.
ex.zh: 新标准旨在将车辆的碳排放削减三分之一。

ex.en: Factories must monitor their emissions and report the data annually.
ex.zh: 工厂必须监测其排放并每年报告数据。

senses: vt. 发出,散发(光、热、电、声音、液体、气味等)
vt. 排放，散发(尤指气体、辐射物)；发出(声音)
emit.usage: 助记:em(使……出来)+it(它)→使它出来→散发;同义discharge,give off;反义absorb vt.吸收；e（向外）+mit（送）→向外送→放射；发出。派生：emission；词根记忆：e(out,出)+mit(send,送,派)→排放，散发。；索引p407

ex.en: The climate change we are hastening could one day leave us with forests that emit more carbon than they absorb.
ex.zh: 因人类而不断加剧的气候变化可能有一天会让我们的森林碳排放量超过其吸收量。

ex.en: emit more carbon
ex.zh: 排放更多的碳

ex.en: The alarm emits a loud signal when the air quality worsens.
ex.zh: 空气质量恶化时，警报器会发出响亮的信号。

senses: n. 强烈的感情；激情；情感；情绪
emotion.usage: [族]emotional a. 情感的；e（出去）+mot（=move动）+ion（后缀）→把内心的运动表示出来→情感。；谐音记忆：“一摸心”→情绪；索引p407

ex.en: Consequently, our feelings, thoughts and emotions have undergone a corresponding change.
ex.zh: 因此，我们的感觉、思想和情绪也发生了相应的变化。

ex.en: Music has the power to express emotion more directly than words.
ex.zh: 音乐比语言更能直接表达情感。

ex.en: He found it hard to control his emotion when hearing the news of his promotion.
ex.zh: 听到升职的消息时，他发现自己的情绪难以控制。

senses: adj. 感情的，情感的，情绪的
adj. 情感上的；情绪的；易情绪激动的
emotional.usage: adj.情感的，情绪的；情绪激 动的；emotional demands情感需求；索引p407

ex.en: Music often has a powerful emotional effect on listeners.
ex.zh: 音乐常常对听众产生强烈的情感影响。

ex.en: She gave an emotional speech about her years as a volunteer nurse.
ex.zh: 她动情地讲述了自己做志愿护士的岁月。

ex.en: Teenagers need support in managing emotional ups and downs.
ex.zh: 青少年需要获得支持来应对情绪的起伏。

senses: adv. 情感上；情感冲动地

emphasis.usage: 复数 emphases；复数 emphases。stress 的近义词；n.重要性，重点；重读，强调；索引p407

ex.en: Increased emphasis is now being placed on corporate image.
ex.zh: 现在越来越强调企业形象。

ex.en: And placing too much emphasis on their opinions can ruin a fantastic home purchase.
ex.zh: 过于重视他们（指孩子们）的意见可能会毁掉一桩绝佳的购房交易。

ex.en: Schools should lay greater emphasis on creativity rather than rote learning.
ex.zh: 学校应更加重视创造力，而不是死记硬背。

senses: v. 强调，重视，着重；使突出，使明显
emphasise.usage: em（前缀，表示使）+phas（词根，表示显露）+ise（动词后缀）→使显露出来→强调，使突出

ex.en: She emphasised the point in an interview at the weekend.
ex.zh: 她在周末的一次采访中强调了这一点。

ex.en: College officials tend to emphasize that the goal of grade forgiveness is less about the grade itself and more about encouraging students to retake courses critical to their degree program and graduation without incurring a big penalty.
ex.zh: 高校官员往往强调“分数宽容”政策并没那么针对成绩本身，而更多的是鼓励学生重修那些对其学位课程和毕业至关重要的课程，避免招致严重处罚。

emphasize.usage: em-(加强)+phas(显现)+-ize→使更明显→强调；[族] emphasis n. 强调；underscore 的近义词；[族]emphasis n. 强调；[近]stress vt. 强调

senses: a. 经验主义的；以实验为依据的
a. 以实验（或经验）为依据的；经验主义的
adj. 以观察或实验为依据的,经验主义的
empirical.usage: em-（入）+pir（试验）+-ical→以进入试验后的情况记录为准的→以实验为依据的

employ.usage: [族]employee n. 雇员；v.雇用；使用；索引p407

ex.en: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.
ex.zh: 在其他缺点中，城市在独自治理空气污染问题时所必须采取的措施在政治层面存在争议，因此该措施也是有弱点的。

ex.en: The firm employs about two hundred workers at its Glasgow plant.
ex.zh: 这家公司在格拉斯哥的工厂雇用了大约两百名工人。

ex.en: Teachers employ a variety of methods to keep young readers engaged.
ex.zh: 教师运用多种方法让小读者保持投入。

ex.en: Every employee is entitled to twenty days of paid annual leave.
ex.zh: 每名员工都有权享受二十天的带薪年假。

ex.en: The company rewards each employee who proposes a workable cost-saving idea.
ex.zh: 公司奖励每一位提出可行节约成本建议的员工。

ex.en: Employers are legally responsible for the safety of each employee on site.
ex.zh: 按照法律，雇主须对现场每一名员工的安全负责。

ex.en: A good employer provides training opportunities and rewards employees for their hard work.
ex.zh: 一位好雇主会提供培训机会，并奖励员工的辛勤工作。

ex.en: Many employers now check candidates' social media profiles before making a hiring decision.
ex.zh: 如今许多雇主在做出录用决定前会查看求职者的社交媒体资料。

ex.en: The survey found that most employers value communication skills as much as technical expertise.
ex.zh: 调查发现，大多数雇主对沟通能力的重视程度不亚于专业技能。

senses: n. 工作，职业；雇用；就业
n. 工作；就业；雇用；使用
employment.usage: 反义 unemployment n. 失业，无业，没有工作；n.雇用；使用；就业；索引p407

ex.en: Therefore, everyone needs to find their extra—their unique value contribution that makes them stand out in whatever is their field of employment.
ex.zh: 因此，每个人都需要找到自身的额外价值——他们独特的可以令其在各种工作领域中脱颖而出的价值贡献。

ex.en: The rise of artificial intelligence may change the pattern of employment in many industries.
ex.zh: 人工智能的兴起可能会改变许多行业的就业模式。

ex.en: The factory's closure resulted in the loss of employment for over three hundred workers.
ex.zh: 工厂倒闭导致三百多名工人失去工作。

senses: adj. 空的,空洞的,空虚的
表示人，名词词性；表加强
vt. 使能够；使成为可能
vt. 使能够，使成为可能
v. 使能够；使成为可能；使有机会
enable.usage: en-（使）+ able（能够的）→使能够；en（使……）+able（有能力的）→使能够；索引p407

ex.en: The app enables you to create your own designs and share them with friends.
ex.zh: 该应用程序使您能够创建自己的设计，并与朋友分享。

ex.en: The new tunnel will enable villagers to reach the nearest hospital within half an hour.
ex.zh: 新隧道将使村民能在半小时内到达最近的医院。

ex.en: Modern technology enables scientists to study deep-sea creatures in their natural environment.
ex.zh: 现代技术使科学家能够研究自然环境中的深海生物。

senses: v. 扮演,担任……角色,演出;发生,进行,举行
enact.usage: v.通过；表演；使发生；词根记忆：en(make,使)+act(do,做、行动)→使…行动→使生效→通过（法律）；索引p407

ex.en: That means more battles like the one now going on between the Justice Department and California, which enacted a tough net neutrality law in the wake of the FCC's abdication.
ex.zh: 这意味着将会出现更多的论战，一如当前司法部和加利福尼亚州之间正在进行的：加利福尼亚州在联邦通信委员会(FCC)退出后颁布了一项颇为严厉的网络中立法规。

ex.en: Congress may enact new legislation to regulate how companies collect and use personal data.
ex.zh: 国会可能会通过新的立法，规范企业收集和使用个人数据的方式。

ex.en: Several states have enacted stricter rules to cut carbon emissions from power plants.
ex.zh: 数个州已通过更严格的规定，以减少发电厂的碳排放。

ex.en: The city council voted to enact a ban on smoking in all public parks.
ex.zh: 市议会投票通过了一项法令，禁止在所有公园吸烟。

senses: 表状态、性质、行为，名词词性
adv. 夺人心魄地;可爱地,迷人地
